head.title: Yaroslav S. - Fullstack Developer
head.description: Fullstack developer with commercial experience: Go on the backend, TypeScript, React and Next.js on the frontend. Experience with REST/gRPC services, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, ClickHouse, multi-tenant systems, booking platforms and public API SDKs.

aboutMe.title: Fullstack Developer
aboutMe.text: Fullstack developer with {{experience}} years of commercial experience: Go on the backend, TypeScript, React and Next.js on the frontend. I build REST and gRPC services with net/http, design PostgreSQL schemas and queries, and work with Redis, Kafka and ClickHouse. I've worked on a distributed task queue library, a public Go API with an official TypeScript SDK, a universal booking platform and a multi-tenant warehouse management system. I have hands-on experience with concurrency in both code and data: race-free slot booking, time interval overlaps, idempotent retries and correct time zone handling. I take features end to end, from the database schema and API to the Next.js UI, and cover them with tests, metrics and alerts. I find bottlenecks with pprof and EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

info.title: [NDA]
list: Worked on a multi-tenant warehouse management system (WMS)
Developed backend services in Go (net/http, gRPC) for inventory, receiving, shipping and stock movements
Implemented tenant data isolation at the API and database levels
Built transactional stock accounting in PostgreSQL that stays consistent under concurrent operations
Developed Kafka producers and idempotent consumers for stock change events, with a DLQ for failed messages
Used ClickHouse for analytical reports on warehouse operations
Built operator and admin interfaces in Next.js and React: data tables with filtering, sorting and pagination
Deployed services to Kubernetes via GitLab CI, set up metrics and alerts in Prometheus and Grafana
achievements: Prevented negative stock balances and lost updates when many operators work with the same items concurrently
Moved heavy analytical reports from PostgreSQL to ClickHouse, removing load from the transactional database

info.title: EPAM Systems
list: Worked on a universal booking platform for services: instructors, consultations, equipment rental and sports classes
Developed the Go backend: schedules, dynamic availability, bookings, confirmations, cancellations, roles and operation history
Solved concurrent booking of the same slot using PostgreSQL transactions, row locking and exclusion constraints on time ranges
Implemented time interval overlap checks for schedules, breaks and existing bookings
Implemented correct time zone handling: storing time in UTC (timestamptz) and converting by location and user time zone, including DST transitions
Made booking and cancellation endpoints idempotent to safely handle retries and duplicate requests
Built the frontend in Next.js and TypeScript: booking calendar, schedule management and a role-based admin panel
Designed PostgreSQL schemas, wrote migrations and optimized queries with indexes and EXPLAIN ANALYZE
Wrote unit and integration tests (table-driven, testcontainers), conducted code reviews
achievements: Eliminated double bookings by enforcing slot uniqueness at the database level instead of in application code
Fixed time zone and DST bugs that caused incorrect slot display for users in different regions
Sped up availability calculation through query optimization and indexing

info.title: Airun One
list: Developed a public REST API service in Go (net/http) with API key authentication, middleware and rate limiting
Developed and maintained the official JavaScript / TypeScript SDK for the API
Implemented a typed SDK client with unified error handling, timeouts, retries with exponential backoff and streaming (SSE) support
Kept the API and SDK contracts in sync, released SDK versions to npm following semver
Wrote API documentation and SDK usage examples for external developers
Covered the API with Go tests and the SDK with Jest tests, set up CI in GitHub Actions for tests and releases
achievements: Simplified API integration for clients: the SDK replaced hand-written HTTP calls with a typed client
Reduced the number of integration errors on the client side thanks to strict typing and unified error handling in the SDK

info.title: MDigital
list: Took part in developing a distributed Go library for task queues and messaging between services
Implemented worker pools and concurrent task processing with goroutines, channels and context cancellation
Implemented retries with backoff, delayed tasks and moving failed tasks to a dead letter queue
Implemented graceful shutdown that completes in-progress tasks without losing them
Wrote unit tests and benchmarks, found data races with the race detector and bottlenecks with pprof
achievements: Fixed data races and goroutine leaks found with the race detector and pprof
Improved task processing throughput by optimizing the worker pool
